meta.name: composio-tool-selection-ambiguity-v1
meta.description: 20 ambiguous tool-selection tasks. Candidates reference REAL Composio tool slugs; descriptions are resolved from the upstream fixtures at runtime (not transcribed). Expected answers are human-curated and marked review:needs-human-review for independent confirmation.
meta.note: This eval only SELECTS a tool. It never executes any tool or performs real actions.

tasks.user_request: Open a brand-new issue in our GitHub repo describing a crash.
tasks.rationale: GITHUB_ISSUES_CREATE is explicitly deprecated in favor of GITHUB_CREATE_AN_ISSUE.

tasks.user_request: Fork the octocat/hello-world repository into my account.
tasks.rationale: GITHUB_REPO_S_CREATE_FORK is the deprecated alias of GITHUB_CREATE_A_FORK.

tasks.user_request: Create a new secret gist with two files.
tasks.rationale: GITHUB_GIST_S_CREATE is deprecated in favor of GITHUB_CREATE_A_GIST.

tasks.user_request: Open a pull request from feature-branch into main.
tasks.rationale: GITHUB_PULLS_CREATE is the deprecated alias.

tasks.user_request: Star the facebook/react repository on my account.
tasks.rationale: The ACTIVITY_* variant is deprecated; pick the current non-deprecated slug.

tasks.user_request: Add a comment to GitHub issue #42 saying it is fixed.
tasks.rationale: Commenting on an existing issue is CREATE_AN_ISSUE_COMMENT, not opening a new issue.

tasks.user_request: Upload my local file report.pdf into a Google Drive folder.
tasks.rationale: Uploading local file bytes is UPLOAD_FILE; CREATE_FILE makes new/empty files, COPY_FILE duplicates an existing Drive file.

tasks.user_request: Create a new empty folder named Invoices in Google Drive.
tasks.rationale: Creating an empty folder is CREATE_FILE (handles files/folders with metadata), not uploading bytes.

tasks.user_request: Change an existing share so that alice@example.com becomes an editor of a Drive file.
tasks.rationale: Modifying an existing permission uses UPDATE_PERMISSION (patch semantics); CREATE_PERMISSION grants new access.

tasks.user_request: Share a Drive document with a new user who currently has no access.
tasks.rationale: Granting access to someone with none is CREATE_PERMISSION, not updating an existing one.

tasks.user_request: Merge pull request #10 in our repo.
tasks.rationale: Merging is MERGE_A_PULL_REQUEST; UPDATE changes attributes like title/body/state.

tasks.user_request: Create a repository under our GitHub organization Acme.
tasks.rationale: An org-owned repo uses the organization endpoint, not the authenticated-user one.

tasks.user_request: Create a personal repository on my own GitHub account.
tasks.rationale: A personal repo uses the authenticated-user endpoint, not the organization one.

tasks.user_request: Get the details of commit abc123 in our repo.
tasks.rationale: Fetching one specific commit is GET_A_COMMIT; LIST_COMMITS returns many.

tasks.user_request: Show me all the commits on the main branch.
tasks.rationale: Listing many commits is LIST_COMMITS; GET_A_COMMIT fetches a single one.

tasks.user_request: Search across both issues and pull requests for the keyword 'login'.
tasks.rationale: Both search issues and PRs; the explicit ISSUES_AND_PULL_REQUESTS slug matches a request naming both. Genuinely close call.

tasks.user_request: Send a message to the #general channel in Slack.
tasks.rationale: The user names Slack; pick the Slack tool, not Telegram.

tasks.user_request: Send a text message to Telegram chat 12345.
tasks.rationale: The user names Telegram; pick the Telegram tool.

tasks.user_request: File a bug in our Jira project PROJ.
tasks.rationale: A Jira project means the Jira issue tool, not GitHub.

tasks.user_request: Add a task to my ClickUp list.
tasks.rationale: The user names ClickUp; pick the ClickUp task tool, not Todoist.

tasks.user_request: Remove only the 'bug' label from GitHub issue #5, leaving its other labels.
tasks.rationale: Removing one label is REMOVE_A_LABEL; SET replaces ALL labels (would drop the others), ADD adds.

tasks.user_request: Download the repository's source code as a zip for tag v1.2.
tasks.rationale: Downloading a zip archive is the archive tool; GET_A_REPOSITORY returns metadata, not source.

tasks.user_request: Read the contents of README.md in the repository.
tasks.rationale: Reading a file's content is GET_REPOSITORY_CONTENT; GET_A_REPOSITORY returns repo metadata.

tasks.user_request: Update the existing file config.yml in the repo with new contents.
tasks.rationale: Writing file contents is CREATE_OR_UPDATE_FILE_CONTENTS; GET_REPOSITORY_CONTENT only reads.

tasks.user_request: Get the details of the single branch named main.
tasks.rationale: One named branch is GET_A_BRANCH; LIST_BRANCHES returns many.

tasks.user_request: Lock the conversation on issue #9 so nobody can comment.
tasks.rationale: Locking the conversation is LOCK_AN_ISSUE; UPDATE_AN_ISSUE changes fields like state/labels, not lock state.

tasks.user_request: Add octocat as an assignee to issue #3 without changing its other fields.
tasks.rationale: ADD_ASSIGNEES adds assignees without touching other fields; UPDATE_AN_ISSUE replaces attributes and is broader than asked. Genuinely close — UPDATE can also set assignees.
